# Understanding Error Codes

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/legacy-apis/about-error-codes
**Captured:** 2026-10-18 via help_capture.py (article payload, canonical text)
**Revision:** node 1416786, revision 3125080

---

The following table lists the HTTP status codes returned by the Zscaler Client Connector API:
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Successful |
| 400 | Bad Request |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 403 | Forbidden |
| 404 | Not Found |
| 415 | Unsupported Media Type |
| 429 | Too Many Requests The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time and exceeded the rate limit or device threshold. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting. |
| 500 | Not Implemented |
